FIELD INVENTORY (compact list contract, schema 1)

Bindings (additive; production Python still uses full APIs): scan_agent_artifacts_list, scan_agent_artifact_dirs_list, scan_agent_artifact_dir_list, query_agent_artifact_index_list, agent_artifact_list_wire_schema_version. Distinct JSON: meta/workflow (not agent_meta/workflow_state), record_shape=compact. Compact query forces Full internally then projects; selection/order/clan/completeness reused. Marker None vs empty preserved.

KEEP (field → consumers)
Record: project_file/name/dir, workflow_dir_name, artifact_dir, timestamp, record_shape, has_done_marker; presence of meta/done/running/waiting/pending_question/workflow/prompt_steps; plan_path.plan_path. Snapshot clan_context + completeness + window + stats.
Done: outcome, cl_name, project_file, workspace_*, model/llm_provider/vcs_provider, name, plan_path, diff_path, step_output{meta_*,diff_path}, error, retry_*, approve/hidden, repeat_stopped, status_label, imported_source_owner/source_machine, recovery{state,reason,reason_text,requested_at,updated_at,episode_id,hijack_id}, agent_session_turn subset.
Meta: name, process_identity/runner_claim_owner_key, pid, model/llm_provider/reasoning_effort/model_alias/vcs_provider, workspace_*, plan_*/epic_bead_id/phase_bead_id/created_epics, commit_diff_path, tribe/agent_tab, wait_* / queue_*, approve/auto_approve_*, hidden, role_suffix/agent_session*, plan_chain_root, clan_*, parent_timestamp, retry_*, times (plan/epic/feedback/questions/run/stopped/wait_completed), question_* paths, imported_source_owner/source_machine, output_path (FAILED workflow), finalizer_status{phase,status,updated_at,instance_count,instances{id,status,op,step}}, auto_restart, agent_session_turn subset.
Waiting: presence; wait lists/follows/bindings; wait_duration/until; queue_*; wait_priority*; slot_requested_at.
Pending question: presence + request_path.
Running: presence; pid/process_identity; cl_name/model/llm_provider/vcs_provider/workspace_dir.
Workflow: workflow_name, cl_name, status, pid, appears_as_agent/is_anonymous/hidden, current_step_index, start_time, error, activity, steps{name,status,output{meta_*,diff_path},error}.
Prompt steps: file_name, workflow_name, step_name/type/source/index, total/parent_step_index/parent_total_steps, status, hidden, is_pre_prompt_step, embedded_workflow_name, artifacts_dir, diff_path, error, model/llm_provider/reasoning_effort/model_alias, output{meta_*,diff_path}.
Turn (meta+done): kind/id/state/label/start_status/stop_status/followup_*; monitor.exit_code + host_completion_status; gate{kind,accent,bundle_path,notification_id}.

DEFER (not on compact wire)
linked_repos; full step/workflow/prompt output (_raw/_data/meta_commits); raw_prompt_snippet; used_macros; done.finished_at/pid/patch_name/imported_transaction_key/stopped_by/traceback/media paths/response_path; instruction_bundle_files; output_variables; meta artifact_agent_id/patch/changespec/bead_id/sdd_prompt_path/commit_*/stitch_id/parent_agent_*/workflow_name/model_alias_trail/origin/proc_id/turn_kind/autonomy; waiting.patch_name/cl_name/eligible_since; running.patch_name; workflow traceback/pdf_status/output_types; turn diagnostics (timeout/elapsed/output_path/truncated/fingerprint/next_*/completion_ref/profile/policy/followup_prompt/attempt/error_stage); monitor command/cwd/starter/tail/pgid/supervisor/settled/idle/tool_run_*; gate creator_agent/next_fork/raw_prompt/workspace_policy/decision_path/claim_holder_pid; finalizer schema/reason/plan_digest/run_id/started_at/runner/instance attempt times; recovery ledger_key/kind/action/successor/model_changed.

payload.entry: Confirmed workflow-list-cutover implementation is on master: be6adc20d0 and regression-fix 8fa9c1ad8b are ancestors of HEAD, and the working tree is clean. Prior phase verification records passing marker-audit, harness/projection, oracle, hot-spare/perf-smoke, compact/integration, import-budget, Ruff, mypy, and Symvision checks; the full just check was not rerun after fix-forward and remains for the land agent. epic-symbols is clean with no remaining entries.

LAND EVIDENCE (bounded-retention): one compact generation + bounded selected detail.

What changed (completed tree vs base HEAD 637a70a0f1, sase-core pin 71c59dca unchanged):
- src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_loader_artifact_cache.py: cache is now one retained generation (max_entries 1, generic over snapshot type). ARTIFACT_SNAPSHOT_CACHE is compact-only; the legacy full-shape index path owns FULL_ARTIFACT_SNAPSHOT_CACHE so a full read can never evict the live compact generation. Same-key lock-busy stale reads still serve the one stale generation; different keys miss; mutation-refusal and bypass behavior preserved.
- src/sase/ace/tui/models/_agent_loader_artifact_index.py: legacy full path rewired to FULL_ARTIFACT_SNAPSHOT_CACHE (alias, behavior identical).
- src/sase/ace/tui/models/_projected_record.py: new bounded selected-detail owner (bound 2: current + previous selection, weakrefs only so roster replacement stays collectible). hydrate_projected_agent stashes pre-hydration list facts and registers the generation; the oldest generation is restored to compact list facts on eviction. Full record trees stay transient in the hydrating worker. New public seams release_projected_agent_detail + projected_detail_owner_size (epic-symbols keyed to sase-1t3.10.1 for the land agent).
- src/sase/ace/tui/util/_gc_policy_config.py: watchlist entry corrected to the defining module sase.core.agent_scan_wire_records.AgentArtifactRecordWire (was the sase.core.agent_scan_wire re-export, which never matches gc type keys); added sase.core.agent_scan_list_wire.AgentArtifactListRecordWire so the census tracks the retained compact representation.
- Justfile: two --epic-symbol rows keyed to sase-1t3.10.1 for the new seams. No --epic-symbol entries remain on sase-1t3.10.1.4 itself.
- tests/ace/tui/models/test_projected_detail_retention.py (new, 6 tests): single-generation cache retention/eviction, same-key-only stale lock-busy, no full-record decode on list paths, 20-selection detail bound, release restores list facts + re-hydration, orphaned generations collectible. Existing full-path cache tests re-keyed to FULL_ARTIFACT_SNAPSHOT_CACHE (behavior contract unchanged).

Measurements (identical fixture workload, /tmp/measure_retention.py, 200 compact rows, ~578KB binding payload, before=base HEAD / after=completed tree):
- cache after 20 generation changes: before 6 entries/1200 records retained, 14 hits; after 1 entry/200 records, 19 evictions. Warm same-key repeat still hits (unit test).
- detail after 20 selections w/ ~100KB outputs: before 20 hydrated retained / 2,080,000 detail bytes; after 2 retained / 208,000 bytes. Zero full Python wire records retained in both.
- decode 5x200 rows: before 1.61s / after 1.55s (load path unchanged).
Real-data smoke (separate process, completed tree, real 375MB index): cold Tier-1 2.03s, warm 0.27-0.39s (25/50 rows); after 10 alternating refreshes cache holds 1 entry/103 records; 7 real rows hydrated with owner size 2 and zero retained full records; RSS 64 -> 242.8MB across loads, flat across hydration. gen-2 pause timing not sampled headless; interactive j/k responsiveness is deferred to the sase-1t3.14 soak, which owns it.
Gate: sase tool run check lint stages all green incl. symvision; diff-scoped test lane joined to monitor for completion.

payload.entry: LANDING AUDIT: At sase fbc1e34fbc reviewed core 8cedd45d and Python be6adc20d0/8fa9c1ad8b/fbc1e34fbc, all four child scopes and every note, inherited decisions, and the linked child/outer plans. Core pin 71c59dca contains 8cedd45d. Production cached/revalidated/fallback/full-history/live-plan/delta acquisition uses compact DTOs and constructors; core selection/order/completeness are reused; marker lifecycle audit coverage is present. Follow-up outcomes are in the preceding triage note. Completion is blocked by actual detail ownership gaps: 20 hydrated replacement objects with one logical identity retain 20 raw payloads (1.9MB) while owner size is 1; both copy_agent_graph and copy_agent_rows_relinked retain unmanaged full detail after the original is released (owner size 0); selected-detail workers mutate/register before post-await identity checks and do not verify replacement object/version; a delayed cache window-25 result overwrites the newer window-50 result (binding calls [25,50,50]); monitor supervisor identity is lost in the compact wire and recovered by caching full metadata JSON. Reproduction script: file:explicit:390183b0f5d7c729aaa2f505. Preparing medium tale sase_plan_slim_list_landing_repairs.md, whose final step closes this epic and parent phase sase-1t3.10 without waiting for its own commit. This turn removes four unused epic-symbol exemptions ahead of that tale because the close guard unions upstream rows; production bounded APIs remain. No source retention fix is claimed yet.

POST-START INTEGRATION REVIEW: Reviewed sase commits from the first core-contract commit time (2026-11-17 13:49 EST), including 8a6451068e/f2fb7fb6b5 before be6adc20d0 and all later default-branch commits through fbc1e34fbc; local master had no missing origin/master commits at review. No later core agent_scan changes followed 8cedd45d. dd56fe2075 replaced the broad import-baseline bump with attributed growth and deferred unnecessary edges; preserve its current cap and verify the import test. cd0b9c5273 already resolved MemoryAuditRow. 81e124eca8 added bounded-cache census consumers after this epic started: the remaining tale integrates the separate full snapshot cache and detail owner into that census so telemetry cannot conceal them. New artifact-read/bead-query caches remain independently bounded; viewer, chop-recovery, and forced-name-reuse commits introduce no compact-row consumers to switch. Destructive name-wipe scanning needs full authoritative owner/link payloads and must keep its existing path. The repair tale will recheck drift at closeout.

VERIFICATION CHECKPOINT: Integration cleanup passes 38 focused tests across compact list wires/ordinary rows/workflows, real Rust parity, selected-detail retention, and marker mutation/path audits (33.11s). This confirms the old compact-running marker audit finding is addressed. Standalone same-identity/copy/monitor reproduction results are file:explicit:b20e7bc07e4622a2fb08abb5. Required just check is ToolRun 6b3ba7450a20b7f13a341f55e64a1f40, still rebuilding the automatically refreshed local Rust extension; it has not passed yet. Repair tale validated with --explain, corrected title/goal metadata, then revalidated successfully with zero warnings. Epic and parent phase remain open until the tale implements the reproduced ownership fixes.

ADDITIONAL CONTRACT EVIDENCE: project_output_facts in sase-core clones every meta_* value, including meta_commits that phase .1 explicitly listed as deferred. A real scan_agent_artifact_dir_list call with done.step_output.meta_details={_raw:100000 x characters} and meta_commits=[{diff:100000 y characters}] retains both full nested payloads in the compact result. Compact done construction can additionally backfill the full commit list through enrich_missing_commit_metadata. The remaining tale includes bounded typed list/action facts, selected-detail restoration for arbitrary metadata, and no commit-list backfill on compact construction. This is another gap in the original compact-payload invariant, not an unrelated feature request.
